hook_text: An elephant is huge, but it has never eaten a single piece of meat.
clip_script: Hluhluwe-iMfolozi. A white rhino mows the grass with its wide, square mouth. Herbivore: plants only. A lion lies in the shade after a big meal of zebra. Carnivore: meat. A baboon flips a stone, eats a scorpion, then grabs a fruit. Omnivore: both. But here is the twist. The lion needs grass too, because zebra eat grass. Every animal's food starts with plants. And you? You are an omnivore.
visual_style: Whiteboard rhino, lion and baboon each above a sign: plants, meat, both, with arrows from grass to all three.
mood: Fun and surprising, like a guessing game on safari.
pacing: Three animals, three groups, then the twist that all food starts with plants.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and sort the animals at your home or school.
